module_brief.purpose: Defines the frozen lld.v1 ModuleBrief/FreezeRecord shape and hand-mirrored TS+Python+Rust validators shared by downstream features.

acceptance.when: validateModuleBrief and validate_module_brief and validate_module_brief (rust) all parse it
acceptance.then: apps/mobile/src/build/lld-v1.ts's validator agrees with the Python and Rust mirrors on the same verdict

non_goals: Does not implement an ajv or JSON-Schema-runtime validator
Does not implement the lld-ready gate's business-rule checks (that is a separate unit)

guarantees.claim: the schema never lets a proposer author an authority field
guarantees.label: kills_structural

guarantees.claim: content_hash is stable across field reordering

derivation.calc: 100 key-order shuffles produced 1 distinct hash = 100/100 stable

guarantees.label: kills_mechanical

alternatives.option: adopt ajv for JSON-Schema-backed runtime validation
alternatives.why_killed: adds a runtime dependency no package.json here lists and no other Orb module uses yet
alternatives.revive_trigger: a second consumer needs full draft-07 keyword support beyond hand-written field checks

alternatives.option: generate the Python/Rust validators from the JSON Schema at build time
alternatives.why_killed: no codegen step exists in this repo's build; a hand-mirror plus the cross-language comparator is the smaller diff

failure_story.trigger: the Python, TypeScript, and Rust validators drift after an edit lands in only one of them
failure_story.blast_radius: the client accepts a brief the relay or fleet silently rejects, or vice versa, and a freeze attempt fails opaquely deep in the pipeline
failure_story.fail_safe: lld-crosslang.sh runs all three validators against the same fixture corpus on every verify and exits 6 loud on any mismatch

freeze.decision: Ship module-brief.v1 + freeze.v1 + lld.v1 as three separate fleet-owned schemas, replacing the single overloaded orb lld.v1.json.
freeze.why: Six downstream features read this shape; a single ambiguous name and a missing R21 floor would propagate into all of them.

killed_alternatives.option: keep orb/contracts/lld.v1.json as the canonical schema; fleet just reads it
killed_alternatives.why_killed: the lld-ready gate is fleet's; the schema the gate refuses against must not live with the proposer it refuses
killed_alternatives.revive_trigger: fleet is ever removed from the loop and the orb both proposes and freezes

killed_alternatives.option: three independently-maintained type definitions, no shared schema
killed_alternatives.why_killed: review-based sync already produced a live drift between fleet's own receipt.v1.json and crew/schema.py; a fourth runtime does not scale that further

predicate.when: all three mirrors validate and hash it
predicate.then: lld-crosslang.sh reports 3 mirrors agree on >= 6 fixtures

sow_seed.restatement: Split the overloaded lld.v1 schema into module-brief.v1/freeze.v1/lld.v1, fix the four carried-across defects, add the Rust mirror, and build the cross-language comparator nothing has run before.

predicate.when: all three mirrors validate and hash it
predicate.then: lld-crosslang.sh reports 3 mirrors agree on >= 6 fixtures

sow_seed.blast_radius: F03, F05, F06, F07, F09, F35 all read this shape; a silent drift here propagates into every one of them.
